name: How long does the shower waterproofing process take before tile can be installed?

mainEntity.name: How long does the shower waterproofing process take before tile can be installed?

acceptedAnswer.text: A complete shower waterproofing phase typically takes one to three days, depending on the system used and the project scope. Preparing the substrate, installing cement boards, pre-sloping, and floating the mortar bed or installing a pre-formed tray takes the first day. Applying a liquid membrane requires at least two coats with manufacturer drying times between coats, whereas sheet membranes install in a single step with thinset. Before setting custom tile or marble, the installation often includes a 24-hour flood test to confirm the shower pan holds standing water without leaking into framing below.
acceptedAnswer.description: Waterproofing generally takes one to three days. This timeline covers substrate installation, membrane application, required drying time, and a standard flood test.
